result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and accompanying pedestrian warning signage. Sidewalks are present on both sides of the road, separated from traffic by grass buffers and mature trees, providing a relatively comfortable walking environment.

hazards.name: Undivided Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross both lanes of traffic without a central refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the zebra crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Speed Control
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway lacks physical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicles adhere to safe speeds at the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crosswalk to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table, forcing vehicles to slow down.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a small median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass buffer. While yield markings (shark's teeth) are present on the pavement, there is no corresponding marked crosswalk or pedestrian signage visible at this location.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing Point
hazards.description: Yield markings on the pavement suggest a crossing point, but the lack of a marked crosswalk or signage may lead to driver confusion and pedestrian vulnerability.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add R1-5 'Yield to Pedestrians' or W11-2 crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the potential presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide residential intersection characterized by expansive asphalt and complex painted gore markings but a total lack of marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks and mature trees are present along the residential frontages, the excessive crossing distances and absence of traffic control devices create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway at the intersection requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and midground across the wide asphalt area

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks to designate pedestrian right-of-way or alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Convert the painted gore/median area into a raised concrete refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distances and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a complex intersection with a large, poorly maintained pedestrian refuge island. While walkways are provided, they are severely degraded with significant cracking and vegetation growth, and there is a complete lack of marked crosswalks to facilitate safe movement across the wide expanses of asphalt.

hazards.name: Degraded Walkway Surface
hazards.description: The paved walkway on the central island is heavily cracked with weeds growing through, creating significant tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks connecting the pedestrian island to the surrounding sidewalks, forcing pedestrians to navigate wide, unmarked asphalt areas.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry features very wide, open asphalt areas that likely encourage higher vehicle turning speeds and increase pedestrian exposure time.

interventions.title: Walkway Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the pedestrian paths on the island to provide a smooth, accessible, and hazard-free walking surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Radii Tightening
interventions.description: Use curb extensions or modular materials to tighten the turning radii, slowing vehicle speeds and shortening the crossing distance for pedestrians.
